LESSON: THE EARLY CHURCH

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.2: The Early Church

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Early Church
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how the early church was started, • repent their sins as guided in Acts 2:38. How was the early church started?
